title: Wearable–cloud positioning for industrial safety
summary: Our preprint on continuous indoor–outdoor positioning for location-based safety management is available on arXiv.

title: Ph.D. in Computer Science at KAIST
summary: I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST).

title: PDRS at IEEE SMC 2025
summary: Our work on PDRS, a self-contained inertial positioning module for wearable navigation, was published in the proceedings of IEEE SMC 2025.

title: Real-time pedestrian dead reckoning at IEEE SMC 2024
summary: Our paper on real-time pedestrian dead reckoning for an IoT-based positioning platform was published at IEEE SMC 2024. The work brings motion estimation onto embedded hardware to reduce communication with the positioning server.

title: Integrated indoor–outdoor positioning featured on KBS and TJB
summary: Our research team introduced an integrated indoor–outdoor positioning system using AI and IoT. The work was featured in news reports by KBS and TJB.

title: Started working at KAIST
summary: I began working as a full-time researcher in the Department of Computer Science at KAIST.

title: M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering at KAIST
summary: I completed my M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering at KAIST, advised by Prof. Chan-Hyun Youn.

title: Engineer's Degree at HUST
summary: I received my Engineer's Degree in Electrical Engineering from Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST).
